name: Sisters of Summerhill
overview: Sisters of Summerhill is an original comedy series following three outspoken, big‑hearted women who reunite in their Georgia hometown and discover that saving their neighborhood is a lot easier than surviving each other. When old friendships collide with new ambitions, the trio faces hilarious missteps, neighborhood drama, and the everyday chaos of life in Summerhill. Through wild schemes, sharp humor, and unstoppable sisterhood, they learn that no matter how much the world changes, family—and the friends who feel like family—always come first.
